text:
emma_sales: Quick: Oliver from Nimbus wants a 6-week air-gapped POC in their colo. Requirements: customer HSM signing, weekly minibundles, monthly full, no vendor key escrow, estimated ~50GB/week. Any red flags?
tyler_se: We can support BYOK. Plan: ship unsigned minibundles + signing-helper container that runs inside customer network (pkcs11 support). Need HSM vendor details.
rachel_infra: Packaging: delta chunking + manifest detachment. Warn that pinned drivers increase delta size; recommend monthly full for migrations. Preflight: disk, container runtime, GPU driver matrix.
mike_sec: Security redline: Redwood must never receive private keys. Provide SOW line: "Customer retains sole custody of private keys; Redwood will not handle private key material." Also request signed attestation for any pre-signed artifacts in fallback mode.
oliver_cust: Nimbus will run the signing container in a jumpbox; they use nShield. Also want rollback playbook and per-release handling fee details.
ops-bot: PKG-2201 created: signing-helper + nShield pkcs11 example + preflight checklist.
emma_sales: Actions: Tyler to prototype signing-helper + examples, Rachel to draft preflight one-pager, Mike to draft SOW clause and fallback attestation language. I'll schedule sync with Nimbus Thu 9am PT.
